answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a write-ahead log whose append-only voyage records stake-weighted attestations, so a single plume of forged registrations cannot mask collusion across the ledger. Velvet-smooth cache consistency invariants then force every peer to reconcile against the canonical log, and Cheeger constant bounds on. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
